scope: Implementation and scoped rate checks are separate from physical completeness; same author.

implementation_controls.name: Cold ee annihilation agrees with direct invariant spin-sum formula
Light-pole free-pair envelope remains below named Planck screen even at unit free fraction
Integer-charge removal/addition energies agree with omega and block cold one-free-s emission
Isotropic boosted daughters preserve normalization, mass shell and energy
Free-streaming numerical integral agrees with radiation-era closed form
Later formation increases the calculated collisionless free-streaming scale
Full-field finite-volume forces equal the variation of the discrete energy
Noether charge plus explicit absorber receiver conserves in every production run
Hamiltonian-plus-receiver energy error decreases with time/space refinement
Complex/real Fourier flux agrees with direct time-domain Parseval accounting
Restricted free-s decay folding conserves energy and creates no net charge
Lossless trace shards reconstruct exact arrays and regenerate selected fluxes
Free positive/negative-charge and real-field waves have the correct flux normalization

physical_population_gates.name: Late retained charge converged within one percent across the tested spatial grids
At least 95 percent of outgoing charged energy covered by the controlled linear particle band
Remaining capture/internal-excitation portal leakage rate computed
Nonthermal mixed-population Boltzmann and Lyman-alpha comparison computed
